lesson.meaning: Showing care and consideration for others' needs or feelings; or, thinking deeply about something.
examples: It was very thoughtful of you to bring me coffee when you knew I was working late.
She gave a thoughtful answer, considering all aspects of the problem before speaking.
Sending a thank-you note after the interview was a thoughtful gesture.
He's always so thoughtful, remembering everyone's birthdays and special occasions.
A thoughtful leader listens to their team's suggestions and acts on them.
lesson.memory_tip: Remember, when you are 'thoughtful', you are full of good thoughts FOR OTHERS!
